title: Logistics Executive
description:
Bachelors degree in Logistics,Supply Chain Management,Business Administration,or a related field. 1-3 years of relevant experience in logistics,shipping,or supply chain operations. Strong understanding of customs clearance,freight forwarding,and transportation processes. Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel) and ERP / logistics management systems.

Key Skills: erp,international logistics,inbound,administration,freight,freight forwarding,logistics,freight forwarders
